packageRules.description: @fastify/static majors can move to a new fastify major, and the deploy template runs on the fastify embedded in the CM's Harper. A mismatch passes CI and the deploy, then 404s every asset at the CM's next restart (.github/deploying.md), so a major waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening a PR on its own.

e2e/ enforces its own 7-day supply-chain floor (minimumReleaseAge: 10080 in e2e/pnpm-workspace.yaml, deliberate - the harness runs on the automation laptop with real secrets). The global 3 days is shorter, so Renovate would open an e2e PR and then fail its own artifact step with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATURE_MATCHING_VERSION, since pnpm refuses to resolve a version it considers too young. Match the floor so an e2e PR is only ever opened once its lockfile can actually be generated.
Treat pre-1.0 dprint/oxfmt (stable formatters) as non-major so bumps group with other deps; regroups normally once they reach 1.0.0+.
